author: iKronix_Gaming
body:
It has come to my concern that the new player minimum is too high.

Not many people are on Avicus at the moment so there is usually only 1 or 2 games of Nebula active. For people who don't have ranks, they end up not being able to join a game of nebula because of the new player minimum. It used to be that if all the active games were full, you could just start up a new game quickly due to the player minimum only being 4. Now it has considerably increased and it takes about 20 minutes to start a new game. 

I'm sure that a lot of people agree with me on this subject and so I would like to bring it to the attention of the mods.

Thanks for listening to my post. Please comment your views :)
